camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --Flag 1 --DBInstanceNetRWSplitType Normal --GeneralGroupName 'rgc-2ze0000'
description_en: Queries all endpoints of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的所有连接地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-net-info --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --flag 1 --db-instance-net-rw-split-type Normal --general-group-name rgc-2ze0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: flag

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Normal: regular endpoint
ReadWriteSplitting: read/write splitting endpoint

By default, the system returns both types of endpoints
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址类型，取值：
Normal：普通连接地址。
ReadWriteSplitting：读写分离连接地址。

默认返回所有类型连接地址
parameters.name: db_instance_net_rw_split_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated cluster to which the instance belongs. This parameter takes effect only when the instance runs MySQL on RDS Standard Edition and is created in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

DBInstanceNetInfo.description_en: The information about the endpoints of the instance
DBInstanceNetInfo.description_zh: 实例的连接地址信息列表

BabelfishPort.description_en:
The Tabular Data Stream (TDS) port of the instance for which Babelfish is enabled.

This parameter applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, see [Introduction to Babelfish]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）
BabelfishPort.description_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见[Babelfish简介]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）

ConnectionStringType.description_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Normal: a regular endpoint
ReadWriteSplitting: a read/write splitting endpoint
ConnectionStringType.description_zh:
连接地址类型，取值：
Normal：普通连接地址。
ReadWriteSplitting：读写分离连接地址

DBInstanceWeight.description_en:
The information about the instance weight.

This parameter is returned only when the read/write splitting feature is enabled for the instance
DBInstanceWeight.description_zh:
实例权重信息列表。

开通了读写分离连接地址的实例会返回该参数

Availability.description_en:
The availability of the instance. Valid values:

Unavailable
Available
Availability.description_zh:
实例可用状态，取值：
Unavailable：不可用。
Available：可用

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The type of the instance. Valid values:

Master: primary instance
Readonly: read-only instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Master：主实例。
Readonly：只读实例

DistributionType.description_en:
The policy that is used to assign read weights. This parameter is returned only for a read/write splitting endpoint. Valid values:

Standard: The system automatically allocates read weights to the instance and its read-only instances based on the specifications of the instances.
Custom: You must manually allocate read weights to the instance and its read-only instances
DistributionType.description_zh:
读请求分配策略，只在读写分离连接地址返回该参数，取值：
Standard：按规格权重自动分配。
Custom：自定义分配权重

ExpiredTime.description_en: The remaining validity period of the instance in the classic network in hybrid access mode. Unit: seconds
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 混访模式下，经典网络的剩余时间，单位：秒

IPType.description_en:
The network type.

Valid values when the instance resides in the classic network:

    *   Inner
    *   Public

Valid values when the instance resides in a virtual private cloud (VPC):

    *   Private
    *   Public
IPType.description_zh:
网络类型。
经典网络类型取值：
    * Inner：内网。
    * Public：外网。
VPC类型取值：
    * Private：内网。
    * Public：外网

MaxDelayTime.description_en:
The latency threshold. This parameter is returned only for a read/write splitting endpoint. Unit: seconds.

If the latency on a read-only instance exceeds the specified threshold, ApsaraDB RDS no longer forwards read requests to the read-only instance
MaxDelayTime.description_zh:
延迟阈值，只在读写分离连接地址返回该参数，单位：秒。
超过该延迟阈值的只读实例不会被分配流量

PGBouncerPort.description_en:
The PgBouncer port.

This parameter is returned only when PgBouncer is enabled for the instance that runs PostgreSQL
PGBouncerPort.description_zh:
PgBouncer端口号。
仅当RDS PostgreSQL实例开启了PgBouncer时，返回此参数

Port.description_en: The port that is used to connect to the instance

securityIPGroup.description_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist for the instance
securityIPGroup.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组列表

SecurityIPGroupName.description_en: The name of the IP address whitelist

SecurityIPs.description_en: The IP address in the whitelist

Upgradeable.description_en:
Indicates whether the IP version can be updated. Valid values:

Enable
Disabled

The IP version can be updated from IPv4 to IPv6
Upgradeable.description_zh:
IP版本是否能够升级，取值：
Enable：可以升级。
Disabled：不可以升级。
IPv4版本可以升级到IPv6版本

VPCId.description_en: The VPC ID of the instance

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

Classic: classic network
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
InstanceNetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型，取值：
Classic：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

SecurityIPMode.description_en:
The whitelist mode of the instance. Valid values:

normal: standard whitelist mode
safety: enhanced whitelist mode
SecurityIPMode.description_zh:
白名单模式，取值：
normal：通用模式。
safety：高安全模式
